column1: # generated by audit/cross.js: two ordinary words (jieba dictionary, frequency >= 5) side by side where the last character of the first and the first character of the second form a phrase-table entry (e.g. 回头+发现, 前面+人们), plus a family pool: for every entry with jieba frequency >= 200, the most frequent common words (frequency >= 500) ending on its first character and starting on its second (方面+条件, 回头+发给, 这个面?+包括). Expected = each word converted on its own. Pairs whose joined reading is the natural one or also plausible were removed (三公里数, 能干涉及, 能干巴巴, 不想象是).
